title: [BUG] Severe performance degradation
body:
## Environment
- Platform (select one):
  - [ ] Anthropic API
  - [ ] AWS Bedrock
  - [ ] Google Vertex AI
  - [x] Other: ClaudeCode
- Claude CLI version: 1.0.98 (Claude Code)
- Operating System: Ubuntu 24.04.2 LTS x86_64

## Bug Description

The performance of the Claude models (Sonnet 4 and Opus 4.1) has severely degraded. Sometimes (just now, in fact), even when I provide specific code snippets (completely correct ones, I just ask it to apply them), it's almost unusable for tasks, consistently fails to understand instructions, and even produces erroneous and useless output. This is a significant problem that I've never encountered before. It's currently unclear why Anthropic would reduce the model's performance to such an extent, making it difficult to complete even small tasks
author: QwQ-dev
